name: hcportal_updateKennelWebsite
description: Updates a kennel's HC6 public website configuration in HC.KennelWebsite. Update-only — the row is created on kennel insert via the TR_Kennel_AfterInsert_CreateKennelWebsite trigger. All style and content parameters use COALESCE so omitted parameters preserve existing values. Nullable NVARCHAR fields use the empty-string sentinel: sending '' sets the column to NULL (clears the value); omitting the parameter leaves it unchanged. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicKennelId in the token param string; the caller needs AppAccessFlags & 0x40000081 (authIsAdmin | authCanManagePublicWebContent | SuperAdmin) on the kennel — a hard-coded mask, not the Permissions V2 editWebsite/designWebsite functions that hcportal_getLandingPageData uses to show the buttons. SMALLINT/INT fields (enabled, scrollBlur, controlFlags) are never cleared, only replaced.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.KennelWebsite WHERE KennelId = the resolved kennel (only supplied columns change; '' clears a nullable text column)

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 179-182: CATCH rolls back and returns the envelope with no HC.ErrorLog row.

codeSmells.issue: Website gate disagrees with the landing-page gate
codeSmells.detail: Line 123 checks AppAccessFlags & 0x40000081, while hcportal_getLandingPageData shows the Edit/Design Website buttons from the Permissions V2 editWebsite/designWebsite functions (which mismanagement roles can grant). A role-granted editor sees the button and is then refused here.
Lines 135-172 do not set KennelWebsite.updatedAt and the table has no trigger for it, so the column keeps the creation time after every edit.

breakingChangeRules: Never change the empty-string sentinel meaning for NVARCHAR fields
Never change the resultCode value (1 = success) without updating all callers
Never change the SuccessResult column names (result, resultCode) without updating all callers
